g.text: Study 5 — Teams consolidate over 26 weeks (replicated across two teams, three lenses)
Figure 5. Across ~17 weekly meetings per team, dynamics (team-state entropy ↓) and floor structure (network centralization ↑, leader eigenvector-centrality ↑, participation entropy ↓) all move
toward a fixed, leader-centric operating point with less moment-to-moment reorganization — consolidation/routinization, replicated across both teams. Trends are Mann-Kendall (Kendall τ), pooled
and per team; dashed = OLS fit; *p<.05, **p<.01, ***p<.001. Unit of inference = meeting (n = 34).
